calls.reason: The evidence is mixed. The tau2-bench repeated trials show real reliability failures, but AlphaEvolve's new 11-dimension kissing-number bound, corroborated by Aalto, cuts against the blanket 'no novel concepts' denial. Whether that counts depends on interpretation.

No evidence separates the effect of credit from the effect of demand on NVIDIA's sales. CoreWeave's debt facility and NVIDIA's own demand comments are both just context, so the causal claim can't be called.

Anthropic's S-1 reports about $4.585 billion of audited GAAP revenue for 2025, and WIRED reports about $4.5 billion. Both are under the $5 billion ceiling. An unstated accounting basis is unlikely to change the plain reading.
The prediction depends on one of these startups dying. Character.AI's Chapter 11 sale is ambiguous as a trigger, and nothing shows the predicted 50% fall in holdings or a broad venture-capital panic.
The December 31, 2026 deadline has not passed. Anthropic's first-half operating cash inflow is mixed evidence covering one company and an interim period, so the year cannot be called yet.

Anthropic's audited S-1 balance sheet shows about $17.4 billion in cash and $2.9 billion in short-term investments at December 31, 2025. That is two days after the claim and well above $10 billion, and Anthropic had also completed a $13 billion Series F in September.
